changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-dcs-query skill.
- Provides comprehensive, read-only query capabilities for Huawei Cloud DCS (Distributed Cache Service), including Redis and Memcached.
- Supports inspection of DCS instances, configurations, backups, slow logs, big key/hot key scan tasks, migration tasks, ACL accounts, IP whitelists, tags, quotas, and instance statistics.
- Designed for daily health checks, troubleshooting, compliance auditing, and performance analysis.
- Utilizes the hcloud CLI as the primary interface and Python SDK as a fallback method.
- Includes detailed core command list and prerequisites for integration.
summary: Query Huawei Cloud DCS (Distributed Cache Service) instances, configurations, backups, slow logs, big key/hot key scan tasks, migration tasks, ACL accounts, IP whitelists, tags, quotas, and instance statistics. Provides read-only inspection capabilities for daily operations, performance troubleshooting, and compliance auditing. Triggers include: DCS query, list DCS instances, check Redis instance status, view cache configuration, backup records, slow logs, big key analysis, hot key analysis, migration task, ACL account, IP whitelist, instance quota, list DCS, query DCS, show DCS, DCS instance, Redis instance, 分布式缓存, DCS查询, DCS实例查询, 缓存实例.
